title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for a smooth 0-form along a segment
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let g be a C^∞ differential 0-form on ℝ^P (IsSmoothForm g). For every a, v ∈ ℝ^P and ℓ ≥ 0: ∫_{(0,ℓ)} (dg)(a + uv)(v) du = g(a + ℓv)⟨⟩ − g(a)⟨⟩. Here dg = exteriorDerivative g is a 1-form, (dg)(y)(v) is the value of the 1-covector dg(y) on the 1-tuple (v), and g(y)⟨⟩ is the value of the 0-covector g(y) on the empty tuple (fun i => i.elim0). The integral is the Lebesgue (Bochner) integral over the open interval (0, ℓ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0), IsSmoothForm g → ∀ (a v : Euclid P) (ℓ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ℓ → ∫ u in Ioo 0 ℓ, exteriorDerivative g (a + u • v) (fun _ => v) = g (a + ℓ • v) (fun i => i.elim0) - g a (fun i => i.elim0)
